positive_prompts.prompt:
Take the role of documentation expert and update the readme for both coolness and for readability, add space using
and give '---' and markup bold etc.
Our project README looks cluttered and boring. Redesign and modernize the README with shields badges, comparison tables, Mermaid diagrams, and clean vertical whitespace.
Improve the visual hierarchy, formatting, and readability of our repository documentation and README.md.
Scaffold a brand new world-class README for our open-source AI project with hero badges, 1-liner install, and architectural flowcharts.
Audit this README for broken anchor links, missing sections, and formatting quality.
Our README is 800 lines and nobody reads past the badges. Cut it down to what a new user actually needs.
Shorten the README and move the reference material into docs/, keeping every link working.

negative_prompts.prompt: Implement a binary search tree in C++ with insert and delete operations.
Configure a PostgreSQL database replication connection pool on Kubernetes.
Train a PyTorch convolutional neural network on the CIFAR-10 image dataset.

description: Trigger evaluation for the README designer. Positive prompts cover both directions users ask from: making a README look better, and making it shorter and clearer. Both load this skill; the skill's own guidance decides what a good answer is. Negative prompts are ordinary engineering work that must not pull a documentation skill in.
